description: The signed-in owner's own After Hours lines and pending setups. New lines use phone minutes; existing per-call lines retain calls. Returns billing_mode, balance (seconds for minutes, calls for legacy lines), minutes_remaining to one decimal for minute lines, forwarding codes and recent_calls. Callers are shown by their last four digits only. Needs lines:manage and changes nothing.
name: get_answering_line
title: The owner's answering lines: status, number, balance, recent calls
